item.title: Wema Bank Launches Voice Banking Feature On Upgraded ALAT Platform
item.description: Wema Bank introduces voice-enabled transactions on ALAT, allowing users to complete banking through AI-driven virtual assistant “SAW.”

item.title: Bagudu: Economic Reforms Boosting Political Cohesion Across Nigeria
item.description: Minister Bagudu highlights reforms under Tinubu strengthening federal unity, investor confidence, and collaboration between government tiers nationwide.

item.title: NHRC Condemns Forced Evictions In Lagos, Warns Against Sit-at-Home Directives In Anambra
item.description: NHRC raises alarm over Lagos evictions and Anambra sit-at-home, urging respect for citizens’ rights and fair resettlement measures.

item.title: ADC Announces 50-Member Committee To Draft Party Manifesto
item.description: ADC has appointed a 50-member policy and manifesto committee to shape credible, people-focused governance proposals ahead of elections.

item.title: Reno Omokri SaysTinubu Has Never Been A Drug Lord, Apologises For Past Remarks
item.description: Reno Omokri clarifies earlier claims accusing Tinubu of drug offenses, says he's publically retracted the statements made before 2023 elections.

item.title: Tijani: Trust And Data Integrity Key To Nigeria’s Digital Economy Success
item.description: Minister Bosun Tijani says citizens’ trust and proper data protection are central to building an innovative and inclusive digital economy.

item.title: Umahi, Bago Pledge To Speed Up Federal Road Projects In Niger
item.description: Minister Umahi and Governor Bago commit to fast-tracking federal roads and bridges in Niger to ease traffic and strengthen infrastructure.

item.title: Dangote Appoints MTN CEO To Strengthen Fertiliser Unit Ahead Of IPO
item.description: Ralph Mupita joins Dangote Fertiliser board as company expands operations and prepares for its upcoming Nigerian Stock Exchange listing.

item.title: Zacch Adedeji: Nigeria Lacks Framework To Tax Informal Economy Under New Tax Laws
item.description: NRS chairman Zacch Adedeji says informal businesses must formalise before taxation, insists reforms target fairness and exclude bank balances.

item.title: Senate May Vote Realtime Electronic Result Transmission, Debates Committee Report Thursday
item.description: Lawmakers consider mandating INEC real-time result transmission and raising vote trading fines to N5m during Electoral Act debate.
